content:
BRUTON LIMITED: Bruton Limited is pleased to announce it has entered into a long-term index-linked time charter contract of 3 + 1 + 1 years with an international trading house for the Mount Vision, scheduled to be delivered from the yard in the first half of July 2026.

The first 9 months from vessel delivery has been converted to a fixed rate of US$95,000 per day, net.

The vessel will thereafter continue with the index linked structure from 1st of April 2027, including scrubber benefits according to the terms of the charter agreement.
